the Pax3/Pax-7 genes are expressed in the trunk and cranial neural crest of chick embryos, and in the melanocyte precursor cells in the chick, quail and mouse embryos, and that the expression patterns of the two genes are different in these cells.
Pax7 is expressed by neural crest-derived cells and that it is downregulated in the melanocyte precursor cells of chick and quail.
Pax3 and Pax 7 are expressed in the neural crest and its derivatives in chick and quails embryos, but only Pax 3 in mice and rats.

the expression of Pax genes in neural crest and its derivatives, and provides evidence for the conserved expression patterns of Pax7 in early trunk melanocyte lineage and for the conserved and divergent expression patterns of Pax genes in the neural crest and its non-melanocyte derivatives.

Pax3 and Pax3/Pax6 are expressed in the melanoblasts of the trunk neural crest, whereas Pax7 is expressed only in the non-melanocyte neural crest-derived precursors of the trunk neural tube.
Pax3 is the main regulator in the early trunk neural crest of all amniotes, whereas Pax7 is expressed only in the chick neural crest.

both Pax3 and/or Pax7 are expressed in the trunk non-neural ectoderms, neural crest, and neural crest derivatives.

the Pax3/Pax 7 genes are expressed in all neural crest derivatives, but the expression of these genes is not conserved in the melanocyte and nonmelanocyte lineage of the trunk neural crest in all amniote embryos.

The main takeaway from our work is that
Pax7 expression is not restricted to muscle development, but is also expressed in the trunk non-neural crest-derived melanocytes.
